work.name: FEMTO-ST, CNRS
work.summary: Working with Dr Daniel Brunner on neuromorphic and photonic computing
highlights: MSCA Doctoral Candidate funded by the POSTDIGITAL+ network (Grant agreement ID: 101169118)
Investigating how optimization itself can be learned as a gradient-free policy, enabling the training of neural and physical systems in settings where conventional backpropagation is infeasible

Attended the International Workshop on ML, AI, Neuromorphic Computing, bringing together researchers in machine learning, neuromorphic computing, nonlinear dynamics, photonics, and physical computing platforms

work.name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal
work.summary: Theory of Materials Properties group, under Dr Nirmal Ganguli
highlights: Used a Restricted Boltzmann Machine, the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, and a secondary feedforward neural network to predict the sign structure and solve for the ground state energy of the Hubbard model
Solved the Bose-Hubbard model using similar techniques as a preliminary exercise

work.name: IJCLab (CNRS)
work.summary: HADES collaboration group (based at GSI, Darmstadt), under Dr Beatrice Ramstein
highlights: Simulation studies of Φ meson production in simulated low energy (4.5 GeV) proton-proton collisions using the Pluto Monte Carlo event generator and CERN-ROOT (C++)

work.name: Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay
work.summary: Experimental High Energy Physics Lab, ALICE Collaboration Group (CERN), under Dr Sadhana Dash
highlights: Studied the effects of longitudinal asymmetry on observables in heavy ion collisions using CERN-ROOT for statistical analysis and the PYTHIA Monte Carlo event generator (C++) to simulate particle collisions
